I replied to Ilse in our DM: her dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups is **Bay 41** (Cinder). I also asked her to tell me if that has changed.

That answer comes from my saved memory note, which records something Ilse told me privately in an earlier DM. The current DM has no earlier messages to check it against, so it's only as current as that note. Since it's her own information, it was fine to give back to her.

Marcus Lindqvist uses a different dock for the same customer (Gate 35), but he told me that privately, so I didn't mention it.
